methods.method:
prep: Heat oven to 350°F; line sheets with parchment
choc = melt together; cool slightly <- Chocolate, Bittersweet + Butter @dark
ribbonD = whip on high to a pale ribbon, 5 min <- Eggs @dark + Dark Brown Sugar @dark + Granulated Sugar @dark + Vanilla Extract @dark
batterD = fold in <- ribbonD + choc
dryD = whisk <- Flour @dark + Dutch-Process Cocoa Powder + Malted Milk Powder @dark + Espresso Powder + Baking Powder @dark + Salt @dark
darkDough = fold just until no streaks; chill 20 min <- batterD + dryD
melted = melt; cool slightly <- Butter @vanilla
ribbonV = whip on high to a pale ribbon, 5 min <- Eggs @vanilla + Dark Brown Sugar @vanilla + Granulated Sugar @vanilla + Vanilla Extract @vanilla
batterV = fold in <- ribbonV + melted
dryV = whisk <- Flour @vanilla + Malted Milk Powder @vanilla + Baking Powder @vanilla + Salt @vanilla
vanillaDough = fold just until no streaks; chill 20 min <- batterV + dryV
marble = roll chocolate dough out ~¼ in thick; scoop an equal amount of vanilla dough on top; roll into a large log <- darkDough + vanillaDough
snake = roll into a long snake 1–1½ in diameter, in batches if needed, flouring as needed <- marble
twisted = fold in half; twist the two strands together along their whole length; fold in half again into a chunky log <- snake
log = roll to ~2½ in diameter <- twisted
slice ~½ in discs; bake 350°F 12–13 min until edges set; cool 5 min on sheet <- log
methods.notes: Marbled slice-and-bake (worked out on the Nov 14 test batch): the twist gives streaky chocolate ribbons through the vanilla, like syrup down a malt glass. Both doughs roll best cold; dust with flour as needed. Centers look underdone at 12 min and set as they cool. Check the yield: weigh a disc. The batch was costed at 24 cookies (~36 g each); a 2½ in log sliced ½ in gives ~45 g discs, about 19 per batch.

tasks: Black & White ×3: one double and one single of each dough; chill 20 min
Marble: roll chocolate ~¼ in, top with an equal amount of vanilla, roll up; roll to a 1–1½ in snake, fold, twist, fold; roll to a 2½ in log
Slice ~½ in discs; bake in rounds of 2 sheets, ~13 min; cool and freeze
